# scripts/Combat/Barrel.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Combat/Barrel.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Carryable explosive RigidBody3D. Power, arrow, blast, and fire strikes light
the fuse; quick cuts and kicks can reposition it. explode() damages and
pushes nearby receivers, attenuates blasts behind walls, chains barrels,
emits presentation/noise, and frees the barrel.

Base: `RigidBody3D`. Registered class: `none`.
